note: Canonical registry of where each model/asset lives. The HF mirror (odobias/npu-hal-over-9000) and the local models/ tree share ONE clean layout (whisper/*, whisper/variants-ov/*, audio/jfk.wav, eval/, deepfake/), so hf == local for every entry today. get-models.ps1 (hf -> local) and push-models.ps1 (local -> hf) drive off this file, so the two stay in lockstep and a future layout change is a one-file edit here. 'local' is relative to models/, 'hf' is relative to the repo root. 'kind':'file' marks single files; everything else is a directory subtree.
